hero.name: Carlota Crespo Suárez
hero.headline: Business Analyst & Product Owner
hero.subheadline: Global digital tools for Compliance & Corporate Governance
hero.intro: Business Analyst and Product Owner with a career developed at Nestlé, specialising at the intersection of business, technology, Compliance and Corporate Governance. Experienced in product ownership, functional analysis, global support and the deployment of digital tools used by international teams.
hero.value: I connect Compliance, Corporate Governance, business and technology to turn global needs into useful, scalable and easy-to-adopt digital applications.
hero.markLabel: Typographic composition with the initials CCS
highlights: Global experience at the Nestlé IT Hub in Barcelona.
Hybrid Business Analyst and Product Owner profile.
Specialisation in Compliance and Corporate Governance.
Experience with Power Platform and Power BI.

about.title: About me
about.p1: My background combines Law, Global Governance, Business Administration and Strategic Business Analytics. This multidisciplinary education enables me to understand regulatory and corporate governance contexts while addressing business needs, data and the evolution of digital products.
about.p2: At Nestlé, I have progressed from an internship to taking on responsibilities as a Business Analyst and Product Owner. I provide worldwide support, collaborate with multicultural teams and contribute to the successful global deployment of Compliance and Corporate Governance tools.
about.p3: I focus on turning complex needs into clear solutions, coordinating the people involved and supporting the adoption of digital tools across international environments.
